# svg-slides set: Bold geometric (`bold`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Saturated colour fields and flat polygon blocks (violet, amber, coral, blue, green) with heavy display type (Arial Black) over a clean grotesque body; high contrast, no gradients, shapes kept clear of every text slot.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set bold --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Slidev "bricks" theme: a colourful, bold theme built from polygon components.
- Apple Keynote "Bold" theme category (Bold Color, Showcase, Modern Type): full colour fields and oversized type.
- tosea.ai "Editorial Chroma": a high-energy orange / teal palette on an off-white base with heavy headings.

Fonts: head `Arial Black, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`; sans `Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: a full violet field; flat polygons (amber triangle, coral circle, blue diamond, green dot) on the right; on the left an amber eyebrow, a heavy two-line title, a subtitle and a meta line. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: a violet block over the left 40% holds a huge white chapter number, with an amber triangle in its corner; on white, the eyebrow, a heavy two-line section title and an orientation line, a coral dot and blue bar as accents. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide on white: a heavy centred three-line statement in the violet accent with the eyebrow above and attribution below, framed by a coral circle top left, an amber triangle bottom right, a blue square and a green dot. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: a violet eyebrow and heavy heading over amber and coral bars; a pale body card with a thick violet edge and an amber key-point card on the left; the graphic frame sits on a flat coral offset block on the right. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: violet eyebrow and a heavy one-line heading over amber and coral bars, a large graphic slot, and a violet takeaway block on the right with an amber circle cut into its foot. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: the cover's violet field and flat polygons, a heavy two-line title, an amber bar, up to three contact lines and a meta line on the left. |
